column1: # mica-vectors-excluded v1: canonical vector path, reason it is not carried here.
# The copy in this directory is canonical at tools/vectors.pin MINUS these paths,
# and tests/vectors-sync-test.sh refuses any other difference in either direction.
# Written because "is the subset deliberate or stale?" is the one question a count
# reason nobody can read is the same as no reason.
# The derivation is a FLOOR, not a ceiling: this repository is a producer as well
# as a consumer, so it keeps every vector for a form it can emit even where it
# would never read one. A path leaves this file only by being carried.
